definitions.explanation: A book, magazine, or other printed work that has been recently published. Often seen in bookstores to highlight the latest releases.

examples.japanese: {好|す}きな{作家|さっか}の{新刊|しんかん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought my favorite author's new book.

examples.japanese: {書店|しょてん}の{新刊|しんかん}コーナーで{面白|おもしろ}そうな{小説|しょうせつ}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found an interesting-looking novel in the new releases section of the bookstore.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on bookstore shelves and in advertisements. Can refer to any type of newly published material including novels, manga, magazines, and academic works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新刊|しんかん}コーナー (new releases section)
- {新刊|しんかん}{案内|あんない} (new publication guide)
- {新刊|しんかん}が{出|で}る (a new book comes out)
- {新刊|しんかん}{書|しょ} (newly published book)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {既刊|きかん}: previously published — books already on the market
- {近刊|きんかん}: forthcoming publication — a book that will be published soon
